payload.text: 25.0 mL of 0.120 M AgNO₃ is mixed with excess chloride.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Calculate AgCl precipitate moles and write the net ionic equation.

accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show 0.00300; Ag+; Cl-.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Explain how the 1:1 stoichiometric ratio between Ag+ and Cl- in the balanced net ionic equation justifies the mole calculation, and state the assumption that precipitation went to completion because Cl- was present in excess.

criteria.description: The 1:1 mole ratio between Ag+ and Cl- justifies equating moles of AgCl to moles of AgNO3, assuming complete precipitation given excess Cl-.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show 1:1 mole ratio; complete precipitation.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Describe a gravimetric procedure to verify the AgCl yield, identifying the dried precipitate mass as the measured variable and the filtration and drying time as the variable held constant.

criteria.description: A valid check measures the dried AgCl precipitate mass while holding filtration and drying time constant across trials.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show dried precipitate mass; filtration time held constant.

parts.label: (d)
parts.prompt: State one systematic error (e.g., incomplete drying of the AgCl precipitate) and predict whether the calculated moles of AgCl would be too high or too low.

criteria.description: Incomplete drying leaves residual water/solvent in the precipitate, making the measured mass and calculated moles of AgCl too high.
accepted_variants: Equivalent scientifically correct notation and reasoning earn credit.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show incomplete drying; moles too high.

accessibility.accommodation_notes: Text and symbolic notation are fully described.
